name: Meng-Xi Guo
evidence: The row's paper was identified: 'Cross-Cultural Scenario Benchmark: Evaluating LLMs' Cross-Cultural Understanding', MDPI Big Data and Cognitive Computing, doi 10.3390/bdcc10090290 (published 2026-08-27), found via GitHub code search in Erikiss/JournalWatch reports/2026-08-27.md, which lists 'Mengxi Guo, Leiming Gao, Winnie Zeng, et al.'. One WebSearch established the author line as Mengxi Guo, Leiming Gao, Winnie Zeng, Gaoqi Rao, Chu-Ren Huang (Beijing Language and Culture University / The Hong Kong Polytechnic University) but surfaced no address. MDPI prints corresponding-author emails on the article page, but www.mdpi.com, doi.org, api.crossref.org, api.openalex.org and europepmc are all blocked by the egress policy (CONNECT 403 / curl 000), so the printed address cannot be retrieved here. GitHub code search for 'Mengxi Guo' returned 194 hits, all belonging to a different person - a ByteDance video-compression/image-restoration researcher (MoE-DiffIR, PromptCIR, MambaCSR, blind watermarking) - with no overlap with cross-cultural NLP, so under the namesake rule none was usable. 'Meng-Xi Guo' with the hyphen returned 0 hits.
